raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation [#44322](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44322) enables DCP for DSA models on ROCm, but DSA DCP still rejects HiCache. On agentic workloads this hurts at high concurrency: the shared prefixes no longer fit in HBM, get evicted, and have to be prefilled again. At c48, P90 interactivity drops to 3.26 tok/s/user. This PR enables HiCache (device + host, L1/L2) for DSA DCP on ROCm, including the MTP draft. It is stacked on #44322 and uses its DCP-sharded MTP draft. **Result** (GLM-5.2-MXFP4, TP4/EP4 + DCP4, MI355X, AgentX): | Conc | P90 interactivity (tok/s/user) | Throughput (tok/s/GPU) | |---|---|---| | 40 | 21.31 → **26.86** (+26%) | 27,087 → **30,712** (+13%) | | 48 | 3.26 → **21.72** (6.7x) | 13,252 → **34,096** (2.6x) | c16 and c24 are unchanged, since everything already fits in HBM there. ## Scope - Only affects ROCm with `dcp_size > 1`; nothing changes on CUDA or without DCP. - L1/L2 only; L3 storage backends are still rejected under DCP. - Otherwise the same limits as #44322: no HiSparse, PD disaggregation, prefill CP or tree drafting, and `--speculative-eagle-topk 1` only. ## Correctness MI355X, `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4`, TP4 + DCP4, fp8 KV, MTP (EAGLE), HiCache `write_through`. **Result: all pass.** | Test | Result | | --- | --- | | CPU unit tests (host pool, draft layout guard, argument gate) | 33 pass | | Guard on GPU without #44322 | Startup refused as expected | | E2E `test_glm52_dcp4_hicache_amd.py` (on #44322) | 9 pass, ~10.5 min | E2E details: - **Accuracy:** GSM8K 0.94 (normal) / 0.935 (device pool forced to evict), threshold 0.9. - **Host reload:** after eviction, a re-sent prompt hits the host cache (`cached_tokens_details["host"] > 0`). - **KL ≤ 0.25:** measured 0.10–0.18, the same range as plain TP4 without DCP or HiCache, so HiCache adds no drift. ## Performance `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-sglang-agentic-mtp` agentic replay with InferenceX, MI355X TP4/EP4 + DCP4, golden simulated AL 3.61, 3600 s profiling window, `--hicache-size 180`. The DCP4 is #44322 without HiCache. Table baseline: 10/19/2026 commit: 33dd8f6a2e | Conc | Config | P90 Interactivity (tok/s/user) | TPUT per Chip (tok/s/GPU) | Chip Cache Hit Rate | CPU Cache Hit Rate | Theoretical Cache Hit Rate | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 16 | TP4 | 53.07 | 17,396 | 71.1% | 22.7% | 97.0% | | 16 | TP4 + DCP4 | **53.49** | 18,175 | 96.6% | — | 97.0% | | 16 | TP4 + DCP4 + HiCache | 53.04 | **18,353** | 96.7% | 0.0% | 97.0% | | 24 | TP4 | 14.07 | 10,872 | 18.6% | 57.5% | 96.2% | | 24 | TP4 + DCP4 | **37.79** | **25,302** | 96.9% | — | 97.3% | | 24 | TP4 + DCP4 + HiCache | 37.69 | 25,252 | 96.9% | 0.1% | 97.3% | | 40 | TP4 | 7.19 | 5,144 | 31.2% | 0.9% | — | | 40 | TP4 + DCP4 | 21.31 | 27,087 | 94.8% | — | 97.1% | | 40 | TP4 + DCP4 + HiCache | **26.86** | **30,712** | 94.3% | 2.5% | 97.2% | | 48 | TP4 | 6.30 | 4,781 | 27.3% | 0.9% | — | | 48 | TP4 + DCP4 | 3.26 | 13,252 | 79.4% | — | 96.5% | | 48 | TP4 + DCP4 + HiCache | **21.72** | **34,096** | 88.1% | 8.5% | 97.2% | - **c16 / c24**: everything fits in HBM (CPU hit < 0.1%) and the numbers move by ≤1%, so HiCache costs nothing when it isn't needed. - **c40**: P90 interactivity +26%, throughput +13%, P90 TTFT 2.08 s → 1.14 s. - **c48**: P90 interactivity 6.7x, throughput 2.6x, P90 TTFT 27.4 s → 1.47 s. Requesting changes on two points. This branch sits on main, not on #44322, so the hook accepts a packed DSA MTP draft whose device pool is still `dcp_replicated=True`. Its host rows then get mistranslated. Separately, the e2e test is registered on a suite no workflow runs. Details are inline. Please rebase onto #44322 (or hold this until #44322 merges) and add a runtime guard on the packed draft pool.

On this branch, `dsa_draft_shards_under_dcp` is only called here. The draft pool still uses `loc_space_scale = dcp_size`, so it's `dcp_replicated=True`. On ROCm with DCP, EAGLE and HiCache, this returns True. The draft then packs into the MLA host, and `maybe_dcp_kernel_indices` maps replicated rows as sharded, so backup and reload hit the wrong draft rows. Please rebase onto #44322. Also add a check in `_build_hicache_draft_plan` that raises when a packed draft under DCP has `dcp_replicated`, since the device pool knows how it is actually sharded.
